VTUNER_HELP_2: !{#33C446}Q: How to use the vehicle tuner?
VTUNER_HELP_3: !{#999999}A: Simply equip the vehicle you want to tune and do /vtuner (team of the vehicle set).
VTUNER_HELP_4: !{#33C446}Q: What happens if I change vehicles?
VTUNER_HELP_5: !{#999999}A: Every vehicle's tuning data is saved differently for players, so you can switch vehicles normally.
VTUNER_HELP_7: !{#999999}A: As you're tuning the vehicle, the price will be updated in the bottom of the menu list. The price starts at 50 points per component but once you cross the 3 component limit (except colors), the price shifts in terms of donator points which can be converted with /convertpoints
VTUNER_HELP_8: !{#33C446}Q: How to get rid of modifications/color?
VTUNER_HELP_9: !{#999999}A: To remove all modifications and colors, you have to reset all parts to None or -1 and if there's not a single part, it'll remove all modifications. Similarly if you want to just keep the color on vehicle, you need to buy/save at least one modification (non color) on the vehicle.
